[[File:Radiation_vents.png|thumb|Diagram showing Radiation Vent placement]]
A '''Radiation Vent''' was a piece of technology used in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. They were employed in service stations such as [[Sublight Drive Station D-639]], where they would be placed next to [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] units, in order to dissipate [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]].
